facts.fact: ARTICLE 19 Senegal's brief says Law 2025-15 on access to information was adopted by the National Assembly on 26 August 2025 and promulgated in September 2025 (25 September per Africa Check).
facts.system: Loi n°2025-15 relative à l'Accès à l'Information

SEN.note: Mentions personal data protection only as an exception to disclosure; nothing on a data protection law.
Document states nothing on public bodies sharing data.
Document states nothing on cuts, punishment or criticism of policy.
